_about: The Early Church Fathers in English: the Ante-Nicene Fathers (10 vols, ed. Alexander Roberts and James Donaldson, American edition revised by A. Cleveland Coxe) and the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series (14 vols, ed. Philip Schaff) and Second Series (14 vols, ed. Philip Schaff and Henry Wace), all 38 volumes as CCEL ThML. Nineteenth-century translations, public domain in the US. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A from Adam's Libronix inventory (the ECF collection, also inside Scholar's Library Silver and Gold). One slug per CCEL volume; titles are CCEL's. The Greek and Latin texts of the Fathers are another thread's work (data/fathers on its branch); this shelf is the English only. No uids minted.
